name: Dreo
description: Smart home air brand (tower fans, space heaters, air purifiers, humidifiers and air fryers) built around air comfort. Its affiliate program runs on CJ with a published standard commission, a 45-day cookie and a dedicated affiliate manager, and the brand also sells heavily through TikTok Shop creator videos.

evidence.summary: Dreo's CJ program details as reproduced from the network listing: 'standard commission 10, cookie duration 45 days, performance incentives 12 commission for actions >= 100, first sale bonus 10', plus up-to-date banners, coupons and a dedicated affiliate manager. Recorded rate is the published 10% standard commission on CJ. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

FlexOffers lists a parallel Dreo route at 8% for online sales (9.6% at 100+ actions) with a 45-day cookie, confirming the 45-day window while showing per-network rates vary; the CJ standard 10% is the recorded figure.

Rateful's TikTok Shop data (estimates, not Dreo figures) reports about 94% of Dreo's TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 3, 2026 came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs, showing a heavily creator-driven sales mix. It publishes no absolute creator count, so saturation stays unknown.

opportunity.title: Dreo Affiliate Program on CJ - 10% standard commission, 45-day cookie

reasons.niche_fit: Tower fans, heaters and purifiers are proven home-tech review and demo content with strong seasonal demand.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Creator-driven selling is core to the brand - most of its TikTok Shop sales are reported to come through affiliate creators.
reasons.compensation: Published 10% standard commission on CJ, rising to 12% at 100+ actions, with a 45-day cookie; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: One route in: the CJ application. No verified affiliate email could be confirmed from a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live on CJ with a first-sale bonus and a dedicated manager per the listing.
reasons.credibility: Consistent 45-day cookie across network listings; rates vary by network (8% FlexOffers vs 10% CJ), which is normal multi-network practice.

name: COSORI
description: VeSync kitchen appliance brand best known for air fryers, multi-cookers, kettles and coffee makers, sold across Amazon, Target and Walmart. Its own affiliate page recruits content creators, food bloggers and influencers with a 30-day last-click cookie and USD payments.

evidence.summary: COSORI's own affiliate page fetched in full. The hero panel states 'Earn up to 15% commission on every qualifying sale', while the page's own FAQ answers the commission question with 'Affiliates can earn up to 10% commission on every qualifying sale'. The FAQ also states a 30-day last-click cookie, free joining for creators/bloggers/influencers, and payment locked 27 days after month end and issued 20 days later in USD. Because the brand's own page publishes two different ceilings (15% vs 10%), the rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented rather than guessed.

Network directories disagree on COSORI's route: LinkClicky lists CJ Affiliate at 3%-10% per sale, while affiliate-forum reporting describes an Awin PPS program at 5%-10%. Awin is recorded as the network with the conflict noted; no cap statement or creator count is published anywhere fetched.

opportunity.title: COSORI Affiliate Program - up to 10-15% published ceilings (conflicting), 30-day cookie

reasons.niche_fit: Air fryers and small kitchen appliances are evergreen creator content - recipes, tests and comparisons.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page expressly recruits content creators, food bloggers, recipe sites and influencers.
reasons.compensation: No single rate can be recorded: the brand's own page conflicts with itself (up to 15% hero vs up to 10% FAQ), so the rate is honestly null; 30-day cookie confirmed.
reasons.contact_access: One route in: the application linked from the brand's own affiliate page. No published affiliate email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and free to join per the brand's page.
reasons.credibility: Major retail presence (Amazon, Target, Walmart) under VeSync; the self-conflicting rate copy is the only blemish and is documented.

name: Jiminy's
description: Berkeley-based sustainable dog food brand making kibble and treats from cricket and insect protein. It runs an Impact affiliate program for publishers and its own 'Chirper' ambassador program on Club, where creators earn cash commission on their affiliate code plus mission rewards.

evidence.summary: Affi.io's network index lists 'Jiminys on Impact.com' with status Open. The program's published terms as reproduced by AffJumbo: 12% commission across the board on eligible purchases, 30-day last-click cookie, $100 payout threshold (wire, PayPal, Payoneer), free to join, closed PPC policy, and the note that 'Jiminy's only works with a limited number of high-quality sites' - a quality bar, not an absolute creator count, so saturation stays unknown. Recorded rate is the 12% Impact figure. No earnings-cap statement is published.

Jiminy's own Chirper ambassador page fetched in full: creators join on Club with 'no minimum followers', pick social missions for store credit and free products, and 'GET 10% OFF AFFILIATE CODE - for every use it gets, you earn a CASH commission', with higher tiers available. The cash percentage is not published on the brand's page, so the recorded rate rests on the Impact terms in the network evidence.

opportunity.title: Jiminy's Affiliate Program on Impact - 12% commission, 30-day cookie; Chirper ambassador tier on Club

reasons.niche_fit: Insect-protein dog food is a distinctive sustainability story that pet creators can build content around.

reasons.compensation: Published 12% across the board on Impact with a 30-day cookie; ambassador cash rate is unpublished. No cap statement.
reasons.contact_access: Applications via Impact or the Club ambassador page; questions by Instagram DM per the brand's page. No published email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Impact program listed as Open; ambassador program openly recruiting.
reasons.credibility: Established Berkeley brand with retail distribution; terms consistently reported.
